description: Landslides is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center. From NASA's Cooperative Open Online Landslide Repository (COOLR). The Cooperative Open Online Landslide Repository (COOLR) is a worldwide database of landslide events. It currently includes NASA’s Global Landslide Catalog (GLC) and landslide events contributed by citizen scientists. In a future release of COOLR, collated landslide inventories will be added by REST API or manually. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center. Its tags are NASA, environment, federal, geography, landslide. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, TXT, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
